+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Prepare theta40 cases; explicitly run only the two authorized short pilots."""
+import os
+for key in ['OMP_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS']:
+    os.environ[key]='1'
+from pathlib import Path
+from datetime import datetime,timezone
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+import argparse,csv,importlib.util,json,resource,subprocess,sys,time
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+H=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT/'scripts'),str(ROOT/'solver')]
+import run_ct_simulations as controller
+import audit_ct_fields
+
+
+def readonly_pin():
+    receipt=ROOT/'solver/athena_ct_diagnostic/frozen_diagnostic.json'
+    digest=controller.sha(receipt)
+    directory=ROOT/'solver/athena_ct_pins'/digest
+    record=json.loads((directory/'code_receipt.json').read_text())
+    assert controller.sha(directory/'code_receipt.json')==digest
+    assert controller.sha(directory/'athena')==record['executable_sha256']
+    old=json.loads((ROOT/'results/ct128_w30_theta32_phi192/input_code_provenance.json').read_text())
+    prefix=str(directory.relative_to(ROOT))+'/'
+    tracked=[ROOT/name for name in old if name.startswith(prefix)]
+    assert tracked
+    for path in tracked:
+        assert controller.sha(path)==old[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]
+    extras=record['extras']
+    runtime=dict(extras.get('runtime_config',{}))
+    runtime.update(extras.get('required_runtime_config',{}))
+    return dict(binary=directory/'athena',receipt=directory/'code_receipt.json',
+                receipt_sha256=digest,tracked=tracked+[ROOT/'scripts/run_ct_simulations.py',Path(__file__)],
+                capabilities=set(extras['capabilities']),runtime_config=runtime,
+                runtime_env=extras['runtime_env'],extras=extras,
+                execution_selection=dict(threads=4,radial_blocks=4),
+                source_verification_mode='read_only_reuse_of_verified_ROOT_archive')
+
+
+def prepare(pin):
+    full=[]
+    for case in ['ct96_w30_theta40_phi192','ct128_w30_theta40_phi192']:
+        job=controller.prepare(case,pin,SimpleNamespace(output_root=H/'prepared',force=False))
+        assert not job.get('missing')
+        full.append(job)
+    meta=json.loads((ROOT/'inputs/metadata.json').read_text())
+    plans={}
+    for name,start,end in [('fine128_theta40_early',9,9.03),('fine128_theta40_knot',23.95,24.05)]:
+        folder=H/'pilots'/name
+        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+        cfg,required=controller.settings('ct128_w30_theta40_phi192',meta,pin,folder)
+        cfg.update(start_day=start,end_day=end)
+        native=controller.native_input(cfg,folder)
+        geometry=controller.validate_config(cfg,controller.parse_native(native))
+        assert required<=pin['capabilities']
+        assert geometry['cell_count']==983040 and geometry['full_sphere_theta_cells']==120
+        if (folder/'run.cfg').exists():
+            assert (folder/'run.cfg').read_text()==controller.cfgtext(cfg)
+            assert (folder/'athinput.ct').read_text()==native
+        else:
+            (folder/'run.cfg').write_text(controller.cfgtext(cfg))
+            (folder/'athinput.ct').write_text(native)
+            controller.atomic(folder/'metadata.json',dict(origin_utc=meta['origin_utc'],
+                shape=[128,40,192,8],gamma=cfg['gamma'],requested_configuration=cfg,
+                geometry=geometry,scope='Authorized short real-boundary geometry/resource pilot; no completed-production convergence claim'))
+            inputs=pin['tracked']+[Path(cfg['boundary_map_csv']),Path(cfg['probes_csv']),
+                ROOT/'inputs/metadata.json',folder/'run.cfg',folder/'athinput.ct',folder/'metadata.json']
+            controller.atomic(folder/'input_code_provenance.json',
+                {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):controller.sha(p) for p in inputs})
+        plans[name]=dict(folder=folder,cfg=cfg,geometry=geometry)
+    return full,plans
+
+
+def limits():
+    os.nice(15)
+    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(90,91))
+    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(2560*2**20,2560*2**20))
+    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
+
+
+def run(plan,pin):
+    folder=plan['folder']
+    if (folder/'runner_usage.json').exists():
+        return json.loads((folder/'runner_usage.json').read_text())
+    assert not (folder/'run.log').exists() and not (folder/'statistics.json').exists()
+    command=['/usr/bin/time','-v','-o',str(folder/'resource_usage.txt'),str(pin['binary']),'-i',str(folder/'athinput.ct')]
+    env={**{k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not(k.startswith('OMP_') or k.startswith('GOMP_'))},
+         'OMP_NUM_THREADS':'4','OMP_DYNAMIC':'FALSE',**pin['runtime_env']}
+    started=time.monotonic()
+    peak=0
+    reason=None
+    with (folder/'run.log').open('w') as log:
+        proc=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=folder,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+            env=env,preexec_fn=limits,start_new_session=True)
+        while proc.poll() is None:
+            peak=max(peak,controller.process_rss(proc))
+            if peak>1152*2**20:
+                reason='process-tree RSS1152MiB cap'
+                controller.terminate(proc)
+            if time.monotonic()-started>90:
+                reason='wall90s cap'
+                controller.terminate(proc)
+            if proc.poll() is None:
+                time.sleep(.05)
+    check=controller.completion(folder,plan['cfg'])
+    complete=proc.returncode==0 and reason is None and check['execution_complete']
+    usage=dict(wall_seconds_including_inputs=time.monotonic()-started,
+        exit_code=proc.returncode if proc.returncode else (0 if complete else 86),
+        native_returncode=proc.returncode,termination_reason=reason,
+        sampled_peak_process_tree_RSS_MiB=peak/2**20,threads=4,radial_meshblocks=4,
+        CPU_time_cap_s=90,wall_limit_s=90,process_tree_RSS_cap_MiB=1152,
+        address_space_cap_MiB=2560,core_dump_cap_bytes=0,nice=15,
+        runtime_env={**pin['runtime_env'],'OMP_NUM_THREADS':'4'},command=command,
+        executable_sha256=controller.sha(pin['binary']),
+        resource_usage_source='/usr/bin/time -v, separate per-process CPU/RSS; no inherited-child accumulation')
+    usage.update(controller.time_usage(folder/'resource_usage.txt'))
+    controller.atomic(folder/'runner_usage.json',usage)
+    controller.atomic(folder/'candidate_status.json',dict(status='completed' if complete else 'failed',
+        **check,native_returncode=proc.returncode,termination_reason=reason))
+    return usage
+
+
+def evaluate(plan):
+    folder=plan['folder']
+    usage=json.loads((folder/'runner_usage.json').read_text())
+    completion=controller.completion(folder,plan['cfg'])
+    assert usage['exit_code']==0 and usage['termination_reason'] is None
+    assert completion['execution_complete'] and completion['scientific_gates_passed']
+    fields=audit_ct_fields.audit(folder,include_entropy=True)
+    s=completion['statistics']
+    ct=s['integrated_CT_work_actual_ghost_trace_code']
+    delta=s['integrated_boundary_energy_minus_hydro_code']-ct
+    work=abs(delta/ct) if ct else (0 if delta==0 else None)
+    gates=dict(native_incidence=fields['maximum_cell_flux_residual_over_unsigned_face_flux']<1e-10,
+        positive_fields=fields['all_volume_fields_finite'] and fields['all_volume_density_pressure_positive'],
+        actual_fast_Mach=s['minimum_inner_fast_Mach_actual_ghost_trace']>1,
+        stage_target=s['max_stage_inner_target_B_error_code']<1e-8,
+        endpoint_target=s['max_inner_target_B_error_code']<1e-8,
+        no_floors=s['floor_activations']==0,
+        local_work=s['max_actual_trace_work_discrepancy_over_total_energy_flux']<.01,
+        integrated_work=work is not None and work<.01,
+        mass_energy=max(s['max_mass_budget_relative_error'],s['max_energy_budget_relative_error'])<1e-10)
+    duration=float(plan['cfg']['end_day'])-float(plan['cfg']['start_day'])
+    return dict(passed=all(gates.values()),gates=gates,usage=usage,statistics=s,
+        native_field_diagnostics=fields,integrated_work_relative=work,
+        simulation_interval_days=duration,
+        linear25day_forecast=dict(
+            whole_process_CPU_seconds=(usage['user_seconds']+usage['system_seconds'])*25/duration,
+            whole_process_wall_seconds=usage['wall_seconds_including_inputs']*25/duration,
+            native_loop_CPU_seconds=s['loop_CPU_seconds']*25/duration if 'loop_CPU_seconds' in s else None),
+        scope='Bounded short geometry/physical/resource pilot; no convergence or full-run stability inference')
+
+
+def main():
+    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--run',action='store_true')
+    args=parser.parse_args()
+    pin=readonly_pin()
+    original={str(p.relative_to(pin['binary'].parent)):controller.sha(p)
+        for p in pin['binary'].parent.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+    full,plans=prepare(pin)
+    controller.atomic(H/'preparation.json',dict(author='Codex-external_model',created_utc=controller.utc(),
+        native_runs=0,production_lock_acquired=False,
+        code_receipt_sha256=pin['receipt_sha256'],controller_sha256=controller.sha(ROOT/'scripts/run_ct_simulations.py'),
+        full_cases={p['name']:dict(output=str(p['out'].relative_to(ROOT)),geometry=controller.validate_config(p['cfg'],controller.parse_native((p['out']/'athinput.ct').read_text()))) for p in full},
+        pilots=list(plans),pin_materializer_called=False))
+    if not args.run:
+        print('Prepared only: '+','.join(plans))
+        return
+    results={}
+    for name,plan in plans.items():
+        run(plan,pin)
+        results[name]=evaluate(plan)
+        controller.atomic(H/'pilot_progress.json',dict(updated_utc=controller.utc(),completed=list(results),pending=[n for n in plans if n not in results]))
+    assert original=={str(p.relative_to(pin['binary'].parent)):controller.sha(p)
+        for p in pin['binary'].parent.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+    record=dict(author='Codex-external_model',created_utc=controller.utc(),cases=results,
+        all_pilots_passed=all(r['passed'] for r in results.values()),native_runs=len(results),
+        peak_simultaneous_own_native_jobs=1,production_lock_acquired=False,
+        pin_directory_file_names_and_content_unchanged=True,
+        code_receipt_sha256=pin['receipt_sha256'],executable_sha256=controller.sha(pin['binary']),
+        sha256={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):controller.sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),ROOT/'scripts/run_ct_simulations.py',ROOT/'solver/audit_ct_fields.py',ROOT/'scripts/audit_entropy_bound.py',H/'preparation.json']})
+    controller.atomic(H/'qualification.json',record)
+    print(json.dumps({k:dict(passed=v['passed'],usage=v['usage'],forecast=v['linear25day_forecast']) for k,v in results.items()},indent=2))
+    if not record['all_pilots_passed']:
+        raise SystemExit(2)
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
